name: riftseer
_workspacesExcluded: packages/reddit-bot (Devvit/npm standalone) and packages/raycast-extension (Raycast/npm standalone) are intentionally excluded — both require npm and are not Bun workspace members.

scripts.dev: bun run dev:api:local & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.test: bun test packages/types/src/__tests__ packages/core/src/__tests__ packages/api/src/__tests__ packages/ingest-worker/src/__tests__ packages/web/src packages/discord-bot/src
scripts.typecheck: ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest-worker/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest-worker/tsconfig.test.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/discord-bot/tsconfig.json && cd packages/web && bun run typecheck
scripts.db:local:up: docker compose up -d postgres postgrest supabase-proxy
scripts.db:local:down: docker compose stop postgres postgrest supabase-proxy
scripts.db:local:reset: docker compose rm -sfv postgres >/dev/null && docker volume rm -f riftseer_postgres_data >/dev/null && docker compose up -d postgres postgrest supabase-proxy && echo 'schema rebuilt from supabase/migrations'
scripts.db:local:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d riftseer
scripts.lint:boundaries: ./node_modules/.bin/depcruise --config .config/dependency-cruiser.cjs packages/types/src packages/core/src packages/api/src packages/ingest-worker/src packages/discord-bot/src packages/web/src
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun test && node scripts/check-docs-references.mjs && bun run lint:md && bun run lint:boundaries && bun run check:wrangler && bun run spec:check
scripts.spec:check: cd packages/api && bun run generate:spec && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json
scripts.dev:prod: bun run --filter '@riftseer/api' dev & bun run --filter '@riftseer/web' dev & wait
